project_title: Um Pequeno Universo Feito Para Cecília (14 Anos)

theme.emotional_arc: Calm -> Curiosity -> Enchantment -> Emotional Explosion -> Calm

headings_and_display.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif text-[#E9DDF7] tracking-tight font-light
headings_and_display.climax_title: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-serif text-[#FBF8FF] tracking-tight font-black drop-shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(232,179,78,0.6)]

body_and_labels.label_badge: text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold text-[#E8B34E] tracking-[0.25em] uppercase font-sans

layout_architecture.structure: Single-page 3-Act Scroll Experience (No Navbar, No standard header menu, No template look)

act_1.style: Radial purple gradient background (#180E29 to #0D0717), tiny sparkling dust particles on canvas, subtle noise texture.
act_1.content: Centered gold pill badge 'para Cecília, 14 anos', massive emotional header 'Feliz aniversário 💜', editable personalized paragraph, bottom pulse indicator 'role para continuar ↓'.

act_2.viewport_behavior: Sticky 100vh canvas/viewport pinned while scroll position drives Framer Motion animations linearly across 4 chapters.

chapters.visuals: Dozens of golden & lilac ambient particles converging to center into a glowing conic-gradient ring (gold + lilac) with outer glow and subtle rotation.
chapters.text: 'feche os olhos, respire, e role pra reviver esse dia'

chapters.visuals: Portal morphs into a rounded frame with overshoot spring scaling, slight 3D rotation (rotateX/rotateY), dashed gold border, orbiting stars.
chapters.content: Editable cozy teddy-bear image container + caption 'cada aventura boba com você vale mais que mil perfeitas.'

chapters.visuals: 4-6 polaroid memory frames enter from edges (top-left, bottom-right, etc.) choreographing into an orbiting 3D system with subtle depth z-index shifts and organic tilts.
chapters.content: Caption: 'cada foto aqui é um pedacinho da nossa história.' Editable image upload / link triggers for each polaroid.
chapters.mobile_composition: Optimized stack or mini orbital arc designed for phone viewports without clipping.

chapters.visuals: Scroll-controlled particle explosion radiating outwards (hearts, gold dust, stars, confetti). Darkened backdrop for high contrast.
chapters.text: Huge text growth 'Feliz aniversário, Cecília 💜' with overshoot, gold/lilac text-shadow and soft 3D depth.

act_3.style: Return to peaceful calm atmosphere with deep purple gradient & slow floating stars.
act_3.content: Subheading 'antes de você ir' / 'um último recado', editable final handwritten-style letter card, custom golden audio player.

custom_music_player.type: Custom Floating / Fixed Minimalist Circular Audio Player
custom_music_player.elements: Circular gold gradient play/pause button (#E8B34E), smooth progress arc/bar, current time display, song title, subtle shine micro-animation. NO native audio element controls displayed.

editable_placeholders.behavior: In-place editable text blocks and clickable photo upload/URL changers so the giver can personalize the message for Cecília.
editable_placeholders.persisted_state: Saved in React state or localStorage for instant editing & viewing.

accessibility_and_performance.prefers_reduced_motion: Detect window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') to replace rapid particle explosions and heavy 3D rotations with gentle opacity fades and static high-contrast layouts.
accessibility_and_performance.performance: Use HTML5 Canvas or Hardware-Accelerated CSS transform/opacity for particles to maintain 60FPS. Avoid layout thrashing properties like top/left/width during scroll callbacks.
accessibility_and_performance.mobile_first: Ensure all text fits inside mobile viewport (px-4/px-6), no clipping, polaroid frames fit in phone dimensions without overflow.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read this file carefully. Implement the full 3-Act experience in React + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion. Ensure fonts Fraunces and Baloo 2 are dynamically imported in index.html. Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements. Maintain strict color fidelity to #180E29, #E8B34E, #E9DDF7. Preserve exact text content in pt-BR.
